_doc: SPEC 41 (size.py) — tokens whose perp mark/index has a known DEX-pool weight, ticker → weight (0–1). Above 0.30 size.py flags haircut_dex_mark (§7: composite-index marks can wick/liquidate you off a venue you're not trading — haircut leverage further). Populate from the venue's index-composition page when investigated; full index decomposition is NOT automated.
_source: Populated 2026-08-07 (roadmap Phase 0b) from the LIVE Binance index-composition endpoint https://www.binance.com/fapi/v1/constituents?symbol=<T>USDT — keyless, public. DEX weight = summed weight of pancakeswap*/uniswap*/other AMM constituents. Board names only; re-run when the board changes (an unlisted token means the veto silently cannot fire for it). Automating this fetch is roadmap Phase 4 (gap F1).
